title: One community. One security desk.
narration: SmartGate AI brings vehicle access, private corridor monitoring, and parking CCTV into one local security console for apartment communities.

title: Every visit has a complete story.
narration: At the gate, a detected vehicle starts an access decision. Our software barrier opens, records a simulated crossing, and closes. Entry and matching exit remain in the audit trail.

title: Arm the private corridor.
narration: For the private corridor, upload a video and arm night security. Real person detection or frame movement triggers a visual alarm and a saved incident. Night scheduling is manually simulated.

title: Connect the response.
body: Parking camera uses the same timeline
narration: A corridor alert turns on a simulated safety light and flags the security desk. Parking CCTV uses the same monitoring module and incident timeline, helping guards see events in one place.

title: A practical community pilot.
body: Measure false alarms and response time
narration: Our proposed business model is a community subscription with optional camera support. Start with a small pilot and measure false alarms, missed events, and guard response time. We make no unmeasured savings claims.

title: Demonstrate honestly. Expand carefully.
body: Simulated: gate, lighting and alarm output
Next: physical MQTT devices + validated PipeGen export
narration: The working prototype includes native CUDA inference, authorization policies, and persistent logs. The gate, lighting, and alarm outputs are simulated. Physical MQTT devices and the required PipeGen export need separate validation. No facial identification is used.
